summary: The Dorado is a video game suited for children aged 10 or above. Its goal is to introduce children into a space base's atmosphere and encourage them to take responsibility for not just themselves but also their surroundings. To win the game, players must balance the four resources of a Moon Base but while doing that the game intends to show them whether how successful they are, people will not always appreciate their work but they should continue nevertheless.
details: The Dorado is a video game created in visual novel format. The game carries on by clicking on different options. The player's mission is to keep the four resource reserves of a Moon Base balanced while also taking care of the passengers of the Starship Dorado who suffered a meteor-shower on their way to Mars. The game intends to let young space lovers experience a commanding position in the Moon. According to the paths they take, take can achieve one of the three endings of the game. By that, the game aims to enrich the storyline and to teach the targeted age group that their actions will have consequences. The Dorado was created by using the engine Twine which uses Harlowe as its language. The code blocks were made with the help of Google AI. All of the images used in the game are from NASA Image and Video Library except the two hand drawn pictures, they were painted by the team captain. The game accesses the images by being in the same folder.
